Class PlayerBoardController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.PlayerBoard.PlayerBoardController
public class PlayerBoardController extends Object
Controller for a single player's board panel. Displays the player's name, food, prestige points and card collections, grouped by character type and buildings. Binds directly to an ObservablePlayerModel so all scalar values update automatically. Also manages the skip button visibility for the main player during extra draw phases.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes all card slots as hidden and builds the parallel lists for character type slots, images and count labels.

    • disableSlot

      private void disableSlot(javafx.scene.layout.StackPane slot)
      Hides a card slot and removes it from the layout flow so it takes no space when no cards of that type have been acquired yet.
      Parameters:
      slot - the StackPane slot to hide

    • setPlayer

      public void setPlayer(ObservablePlayerModel playerModel, ClientController clientController, boolean isMainPlayer)
      Binds this board to the given player model and sets up all listeners.
      Parameters:
      playerModel - the observable player model to bind to
      clientController - the client controller used to send game actions
      isMainPlayer - true if this board belongs to the local player

    • bind

      private void bind()
      Binds all labels to the player model properties and registers listeners for new character and building cards. Label colors are derived from the player's assigned color.

    • addBuildingCard

      private void addBuildingCard(CardDTO card)
      Adds a new building card to the dedicated building slot.
      Parameters:
      card - the building card DTO to add

    • addCharacterCard

      private void addCharacterCard(CardDTO card)
      Adds a new character card to the slot corresponding to its character type. Uses the character type to select the correct slot from the parallel lists.
      Parameters:
      card - the character card DTO to add

    • setHeaderFlipped

      public void setHeaderFlipped()
      Rotates the header box by 180 degrees. Used when this player board is displayed at the top of the screen so the name and points are readable from the correct orientation.

    • updateSkipButton

      public void updateSkipButton(GameState currentState, boolean isExtraDrawPhase, boolean isMyTurn)
      Updates the visibility and enabled state of the skip button. The button is shown only for the main player during the RESOLVING_ACTIONS state when an extra draw phase is active and when isMyTurn is true.
      Parameters:
      currentState - the current game state
      isExtraDrawPhase - whether the game is currently in an extra draw phase

    • onSkipClicked

      private void onSkipClicked()
      Handles the skip button click. Hides the button and sends the skip action to the server.

    • onSkipHover

      private void onSkipHover()
      Applies the hover effect to the skip button when the mouse enters it. Ignored if the button is currently disabled.

    • onSkipHoverExit

      private void onSkipHoverExit()
      Restores the default style of the skip button when the mouse exits it.
